arabic_text: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَا أَهْلَ بَيْتِ ٱلنُّبُوَّةِ وَمَوْضِعَ ٱلرِّسَالَةِ وَمُخْتَلَفَ ٱلْمَلاَئِكَةِ وَمَهْبِطَ ٱلْوَحْيِ
transliteration: al-salāmu ʿalaykum yā ahla bayti al-nubuwwah. wa mawḍiʿa al-risālah. wa mukhtalafa al-mala'ikati wamaḥbiṭa al-waḥyِ.
english_text: Peace be upon you, O Household of Prophethood, location of the Divine mission, frequently visited by the angels, destination of the Divine revelation,

arabic_text: وَمَعْدِنَ ٱلرَّحْمَةِ وَخُزَّانَ ٱلْعِلْمِ وَمُنْتَهَىٰ ٱلْحِلْمِ وَأُصُولَ ٱلْكَرَمِ
transliteration: wa ma'dinat ar-rahmah wa khuzzāna al-ʿilm. wa muntaḥā alhilmi wa usul al-karami.
english_text: core of mercy, treasurers of knowledge, ultimate degree of forbearance, origins of generosity,

arabic_text: وَقَادَةَ ٱلْأُمَمِ وَأَوْلِيَاءَ ٱلنِّعَمِ وَعَنَاصِرَ ٱلْأَبْرَارِ وَدَعَائِمَ ٱلْأَخْيَارِ
transliteration: wa qādat al-umamī. wa-awliyā'a al-niʿam. wa'anāṣira al-abrār. wadaʿā'ima al-akh'yār
english_text: leaders of all nations, sustainers of bounties, foundations of the dutiful, pillars of the upright,

arabic_text: وَسَاسَةَ ٱلْعِبَادِ وَأَرْكَانَ ٱلْبِلاَدِ وَأَبْوَابَ ٱلْإِيـمَانِ وَأُمَنَاءَ ٱلرَّحْمٰنِ
transliteration: wasāsatal-ʿibādِ wa-ar'kana al-bilad. wa abwāb al-īmān. wa-umana'a al-raḥmānِ.
english_text: maintainers of the servants (of Allah), props of the lands, doors to true faith, trustees of the All-beneficent (Allah),

arabic_text: وَسُلاَلَةَ ٱلنَّبِيِّينَ وَصَفْوَةَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ وَعِتْرَةَ خِيَرَةِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
transliteration: wasulalatan-nabiyin. waṣafwat al-mursalīn waʿitrata khayrati rabbi al-ʿalameen.
english_text: descendants of the Prophets, choice of the Messengers, and offspring of the select of the Lord of the worlds.

arabic_text: وَرَحْمَةُ ٱللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ
transliteration: wa raḥmatu llāhi wa barakātuhu.
english_text: Allah’s mercy and blessings, too, be upon you (all).

arabic_text: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ أَئِمَّةِ ٱلْهُدَىٰ وَمَصَابِيحِ ٱلدُّجَىٰ وَأَعْلاَمِ ٱلتُّقَىٰ وَذَوِي ٱلنُّهَىٰ
transliteration: al-salāmu ʿalā aʾimmah al-hudā. wa maṣābīḥi al-dujā. wa'a'lamit-tuqā. wa ḏawī al-nuhā.
english_text: Peace be upon the directors of right guidance, the lanterns in darkness, the patterns of piety, the owners of understanding,

arabic_text: وَأُوْلِي ٱلْحِجَىٰ وَكَهْفِ ٱلْوَرَىٰ وَوَرَثَةِ ٱلْأَنْبِيَاءِ وَٱلْمَثَلِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
transliteration: wa ʾūlī al-ḥijāh wa kahfi al-waraa' wa warathati al-anbiyaʾ. wa-l-mathali al-a'la.
english_text: the endued with thought, the havens for the peoples, the inheritors of the Prophets, the perfect specimen,

arabic_text: وَٱلدَّعْوَةِ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ وَحُجَجِ ٱللَّهِ عَلَىٰ أَهْلِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْآخِرَةِ وَٱلْأُولَىٰ
transliteration: wa al-daʿwat al-ḥusná. wa ḥujajillāhi ʿalā ahlid-dunyā. wal-akhira wa al-ula.
english_text: the most excellent call, and the arguments of Allah against the inhabitants of the world, the Hereafter, and the former world.

arabic_text: وَرَحْمَةُ ٱللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ
transliteration: wa raḥmatu llāhi wa barakātuhu.
english_text: Allah’s mercy and blessings, too, be upon you (all).

arabic_text: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ مَحَالِّ مَعْرِفَةِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَسَاكِنِ بَرَكَةِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَعَادِنِ حِكْمَةِ ٱللَّهِ وَحَفَظَةِ سِرِّ ٱللَّهِ
transliteration: al-salāmu ʿalā maḥalli maʿrifatillāh. wamāsākini barakatillah. wa maʿādini ḥikmati allahi. waḥafẓati sirrillāh.
english_text: Peace be upon the exponents of the recognition of Allah, the centers of Allah’s blessing, the essence of Allah’s wisdom, the keepers of Allah’s secrets,

arabic_text: وَحَمَلَةِ كِتَابِ ٱللَّهِ وَأَوْصِيَاءِ نَبِيِّ ٱللَّهِ وَذُرِّيَّةِ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ
transliteration: wa ḥamalati kitābi llāh. wa-awṣiyāʾi nabiyyillāh. wa dhurriyyati rasoolillah. ṣalla llāhu ʿalayhi wa ālihi.
english_text: the bearers of Allah’s Book, the successors of Allah’s Prophet, and the progeny of Allah’s Messenger, may Allah send blessings upon him and his Household.

arabic_text: وَرَحْمَةُ ٱللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ
transliteration: wa-raḥmatu llāh wa-barakātuhu.
english_text: Allah’s mercy and blessings, too, be upon them.

arabic_text: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ ٱلدُّعَاةِ إِلَىٰ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلْأَدِلاَّءِ عَلَىٰ مَرْضَاتِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلْمُسْتَقِرِّينَ فِي أَمْرِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلتَّامِّينَ فِي مَحَبَّةِ ٱللَّهِ
transliteration: al-salāmu ʿalā al-duʿāt ilā allāh. wa al-adillati ʿalā marḍātillāh. wal-mustaqqirrina fi amri allah. wa-l-tāmmīna fī maḥabbati allāh.
english_text: Peace be upon the callers to Allah, the leaders to Allah’s pleasure, the abiders by Allah’s decree, the perfect in love for Allah,

arabic_text: وَٱلْمُخْلِصِينَ فِي تَوْحِيدِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلْمُظْهِرِينَ لِأَمْرِ ٱللَّهِ وَنَهْيِهِ وَعِبَادِهِ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَسْبِقُونَهُ بِٱلْقَوْلِ
transliteration: wal-mukhliṣīna fī tawḥīdi llāh. wa al-mudh-hirīna li-amri l-lāhi wa nahyihi. wa ʿibādih al-mukramīn. alladhīna lā yasbiqūnahu bilqawl
english_text: the sincere in professing Allah’s Oneness, the manifesters of Allah’s orders and prohibitions, and Allah’s honored bondmen who speak not until He has spoken

arabic_text: وَهُمْ بِأَمْرِهِ يَعْمَلُونَ
transliteration: wa hum bi-amrihi ya'maloon.
english_text: and act by His command.

arabic_text: وَرَحْمَةُ ٱللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ
transliteration: warahmatu llāhi wabarakaatuhu
english_text: Allah’s mercy and blessings, too, be upon them.

arabic_text: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ ٱلْأَئِمَّةِ ٱلدُّعَاةِ وَٱلْقَادَةِ ٱلْهُدَاةِ وَٱلسَّادَةِ ٱلْوُلاَةِ وَٱلذَّادَةِ ٱلْحُمَاةِ
transliteration: al-salāmu ʿalā al-aʾimmati al-duʿāt. wal-qādāti al-hudā. wa al-sādāti al-wulāt. wa al-ḏ-ḏādati al-ḥumāh
english_text: Peace be upon the Imams, the heralds, the leaders, the guides, the chiefs, the authorities, the defenders, the protectors,

arabic_text: وَأَهْلِ ٱلذِّكْرِ وَأُوْلِي ٱلْأَمْرِ وَبَقِيَّةِ ٱللَّهِ وَخِيَرَتِهِ وَحِزْبِهِ وَعَيْبَةِ عِلْمِهِ
transliteration: wa ahl al-dhikr wa ʾuli al-amr. wa baqiyyatil-lahi wa khayratih. waḥibihī wa ʿaybatī ʿilmihi.
english_text: the people of the Reminder (i.e. the Qur'an), the men in authority, the left ones by Allah, His select, His party, the case of His knowledge

arabic_text: وَحُجَّتِهِ وَصِرَاطِهِ وَنُورِهِ وَبُرْهَانِهِ
transliteration: waḥujjatihī waṣirāṭihī wa nūrihi wa burhānihī
english_text: His argument, His path, His light, and His proof.

arabic_text: وَرَحْمَةُ ٱللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ
transliteration: wa raḥmatu'llāhi wa barakātuhu.
english_text: Allah’s mercy and blessings, too, be upon them.

arabic_text: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ ٱللَّهُ
transliteration: ashhadu anna la ilaha illa allah.
english_text: I bear witness that there is no god save Allah;

arabic_text: وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ كَمَا شَهِدَ ٱللَّهُ لِنَفْسِهِ وَشَهِدَتْ لَهُ مَلاَئِكَتُهُ وَأُوْلُو ٱلْعِلْمِ مِنْ خَلْقِهِ
transliteration: waḥdahu lā sharīka lah. kamā shahida allah li-nafsihi. wa shahidat lahu mala'ikatuhu. wa-ʾūlū al-ʿilm min khalkihi.
english_text: One and Only and having no partner with Him just as Allah has testified to His Oneness to which His angels and his knowledgeable creatures testify.

arabic_text: لَا إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
transliteration: lā ʾilāha ʾillā huwa al-ʿazīzu al-ḥakīmu.
english_text: There is no god save Him; the Almighty, the All-wise.

arabic_text: وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُهُ ٱلْمُنْتَجَبُ وَرَسُولُهُ ٱلْمُرْتَضَىٰ
transliteration: wa-ashhadu anna muḥammadan ʿabduhu al-muntajabu wa rasuluhu al-murtadha
english_text: I also bear witness that Muhammad is His elect servant and His approved Messenger.

arabic_text: أَرْسَلَهُ بِٱلْهُدَىٰ وَدِينِ ٱلْحَقِّ لِيُظْهِرَهُ عَلَىٰ ٱلدِّينِ كُلِّهِ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ ٱلْمُشْرِكُونَ
transliteration: arsalahu bilhuda wa dini alhaqqi. li-yuzhirahu 'ala al-deeni kullihi. wa law kariha al-mushrikun.
english_text: He sent him with right guidance and with the Religion of truth that He may cause it to prevail over all religions however much the idol-worshippers may be averse.

arabic_text: وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّكُمُ ٱلْأَئِمَّةُ ٱلرَّاشِدُونَ ٱلْمَهْدِيُّونَ ٱلْمَعْصُومُونَ ٱلْمُكَرَّمُونَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ ٱلْمُتَّقُونَ ٱلصَّادِقُونَ
transliteration: wa-ashhadu annakumu al-a'immatu al-rashidun. al-mahdiyyūn al-maʿṣūmūn. al-mukarramūn al-muqarrabūn. al-muttaqūna al-ṣādiqūna.
english_text: I also bear witness that you all are the Imams, rightly guiding, well-guided, infallible, highly revered, drawn near (to Allah), pious, veracious,

arabic_text: ٱلْمُصْطَفَوْنَ ٱلْمُطيعُونَ لِلَّهِ ٱلْقَوَّامُونَ بِأَمْرِهِ ٱلْعَامِلُونَ بِإِرَادَتِهِ ٱلْفَائِزُونَ بِكَرَامَتِهِ
transliteration: al-muṣṭafawna al-muṭiʿūna lillāh. al-qawwamoon bi-amrihi. al-ʿāmilūna bi-irādatihi. al-fāʾizoona bi karāmatihi.
english_text: well-chosen, obedient to Allah, establishing His rule, putting into practice His will, and winning His honoring.

arabic_text: إِصْطَفَاكُمْ بِعِلْمِهِ وَٱرْتَضَاكُمْ لِغَيْبِهِ وَٱخْتَارَكُمْ لِسِرِّهِ وَٱجْتَبَاكُمْ بِقُدْرَتِهِ
transliteration: 'iṣṭafākum bi'ilmihī. wa-irtaḍākum li-ghaybihi. wa ikhtarakum lisirrihi wa-ijtabākum bi-qudratih.
english_text: He chose you on account of His (eternal) knowledge, approved of you to maintain His unseen knowledge, selected you to keep His secret, decided on you by means of His omnipotence,

arabic_text: وَأَعَزَّكُمْ بِهُدَاهُ وَخَصَّكُمْ بِبُرْهَانِهِ وَٱنْتَجَبَكُمْ لِنُورِهِ وَأَيَّدَكُمْ بِرُوحِهِ
transliteration: wa'a'azzakum bihudaahu wa khassakum bi burhaniih. wa-antajabakum li-noorihi. wa ʾayyadakum bi-rūḥihi
english_text: equipped you with His guidance, distinguished you with His clear proofs, chose you to hold His Light, supported you with His Holy spirit,
